effect.hatmod.veil.description: Plain vanilla Invisibility (the status bar shows this Divine Veil entry only, never a separate Invisibility one): the model vanishes exactly as vanilla does, while armour and held items stay visible. Kept up while flashing, then lasts another 6/8/10s (by Radiance level); while veiled it periodically shakes off mobs that had already locked onto you.
enchantment.hatmod.afterimage.desc: One extra blink-dodge during the beam phase per level (3 total at III); the dodged hit misses completely.
enchantment.hatmod.benediction.desc: The permanent Speed and Jump Boost are one level higher per level (Jump Boost caps at II).
enchantment.hatmod.bloodthirst.desc: Damage dealt by the beam heals you for 5% per level, uncapped; healing that overflows at full health becomes green hearts with no loss - a separate shield that outranks golden hearts: incoming damage drains green hearts first, and only then golden hearts and health. Green hearts last forever but decay faster the more you have (1s per heart at the base, exponentially quicker as the pool grows). Vanilla golden hearts are untouched.
enchantment.hatmod.conflagration.desc: Every hat naturally fires 2 beams at once; each beam deals half the old single-beam damage, so the pair matches the old total, and the two stack on the same target with no falloff. This enchantment adds one more per level (3/4/5 total at I/II/III): with enough enemies each takes a different one; with too few (a lone boss) the extra beams stack on the nearest enemies with diminishing returns (the 2nd/3rd extra beam on the same target = 40%/16%), while the base two never lose damage.
enchantment.hatmod.dominion.desc: +5s per level: at charge second 15, the 5 nearest enemies lose their target (+5 per level, up to 15) and are outlined. A dominated mob that still has other enemies nearby is turned on them instead. Works on Wardens too: their target lives in brain memory, so it is wiped together with their anger.
enchantment.hatmod.formless.desc: One extra blink-dodge during the charge phase per level (6 total at III).
enchantment.hatmod.radiance.desc: While firing, you and every ally inside the time-dilation field gain Divine Veil (widen the field with Slow Field and the veil covers more of them) - plain vanilla Invisibility, the model vanishing exactly as vanilla does, plus it periodically shakes off mobs that had already locked onto you, Wardens included. Divine Veil lasts 6/8/10s (by this enchantment's level) and is topped back up when under 2s remain, so it keeps going that long after the beam ends. No longer adds beam damage.
enchantment.hatmod.requiem.desc: The time-dilation field's radius grows by 1 block per level.
enchantment.hatmod.soul_reap.desc: The moment your charge completes, pin every enemy within 30 blocks - exactly the same effect as the charging time-dilation field. The duration scales with this enchantment's level: 1/3, 2/3 or 3/3 of what is left of the cycle (level III lasts the whole cycle). From the moment it starts, your view stays black-and-white for the whole duration, and "I saw this coming." appears.
